newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile to send Canada trade accord to Congress.
newsitem.headline: Chile to send Canada trade accord to Congress.

text.p: The Chilean government will send a free trade agreement with Canada signed late last year to Congress next week for approval, said the Foreign Ministry's top trade negotiator Juan Gabriel Valdes.
"The treaty should be approved before June 2, which is the date agreed with Canada," Valdes told a news conference.
Chile regards the bilateral trade accord as a step towards the country's eventual membership of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), which links the United States, Canada and Mexico.
Chile has already signed a free trade pact with Mexico.
